people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

translations.web: For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for judgment.
translations.bsb: When My sword has drunk its fill in the heavens, then it will come down upon Edom, upon the people I have devoted to destruction.
translations.kjv: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
translations.asv: For my sword hath drunk its fill in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Edom, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
